title: Ensure inactive users are reviewed and removed periodically
description: An account nobody uses is an account nobody notices being used. Dormant credentials with repository access are a standing invitation, and they also consume licences.
remediation: Administration -> Users: for each listed account, either deactivate it or remove the grants that give it repository access. Where accounts come from an external directory, disable them there — Bitbucket will follow. Adjust the window with thresholds.inactiveUserDays in bitbucket-bench's config.
fixSummary: Deactivate each listed account at Administration -> Users.
